t: The Loud House S6 - Space Jammed / Crown and Dirty
d: Annoyed by Leni's intrusive babysitting, Lisa accidentally blasts herself and Todd into space. // Lola tries to whip Mom into tip-top pageant condition for a Mother-Daughter pageant.

t: The Marsupilamis S1 - Parrot pickle / On the Campaign Tail
d: Hope charms a flock of parrots guarding a fig tree and they make her their leader. // It's School President election time and the Twins are running against each other and Bibi!

t: SpongeBob SquarePants S15 - Wary Gary / Pinned
d: SpongeBob goes to extreme lengths to trick Gary into going to the vet. // SpongeBob become desperate when he accidentally gets pinned under his exercise equipment and must wait for help to arrive.

t: The Patrick Star Show S5 - Squ-AD-ina / Don't Friend the Reaper
d: Squidina and SpongeBob shoot advertisements to fund the Patrick Show. // GrandPat takes over Death's job for a day.

d: SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a strange town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgangers. // After Squidward loses his memory, he adopts a new tough guy persona.

t: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - Little Yellow Book
d: Squidward finds SpongeBob's diary, and starts reading it out loud in the Krusty Krab.

t: The Loud House S10 - Student of the Jeer / Bean Dreams
d: Hoping to change her reputation at school, Stella tries to prove that she's not the teachers' pet. // Lori explores a potential career path after her boss suggests she has a strong future within the Burnt Bean organization.

t: The Loud House S9 - The Kanga-ruse / The Walking Bed
d: When it appears the kangaroo mascot Crikey has vandalized the school, The Action News Team tries to prove his innocence. // Lincoln finds ways to break a family rule about hand-me-downs so he can get Lori's old mattress instead of his sisters.

t: The Loud House S6 - Sleepstakes
d: The Loud kids help Lana get over her fear of sleepovers.

t: That Girl Lay Lay S2 - The Packer Packer Bowl
d: Bacon becomes the West Packer High football mascot, but when the school's rival steals him as part of a prank, Lay Lay will stop at nothing to get her beloved pig back.

d: Max and Phoebe attend Parent-Teacher Night, leaving Chloe and friends home without adult supervision. When Jinx finds the Air Lair, he believes spies are targeting the school, and his meddling puts the Thundermans' school jobs at risk.

t: Henry Danger S1 - Birthday Girl Down
d: Henry is not invited to a birthday party because he is accused of throwing the birthday girl off the roof the previous year. Captain Man agrees to help Henry clear his name.

t: Henry Danger S3 - Swellview's Got Talent
d: After discovering contestants on Swellview's Got Talent are losing consciousness, Captain Man and Kid Danger enlist the help of Charlotte and Schwoz in order to find out what is causing the mischief.

t: Danger Force S2 - Chapa's Phone Home
d: When Chapa's beloved long lost cell phone returns to the Man's Nest under mysterious circumstances, her hunt for the truth threatens to destroy Danger Force.

t: iCarly S2 - iTwins
d: Freddie tries to prove that Melanie, Sam's twin sister, is just Sam in disguise. Meanwhile, when Carly tutors Spencer's nemesis, Chuck, Spencer tries to convince her that Chuck is evil.

t: iCarly S2 - iTake on Dingo
d: The Dingo channel has apparently been stealing ideas from iCarly, so Carly, Sam, Freddie, and Spencer go to the Dingo studio to give the writers a piece of their mind.

t: Victorious S3 - Driving Tori Crazy
d: When a movie shoot causes a traffic jam and extends Tori's morning commute, Tori attempts to find a bearable driving companion amongst her friends. Cat gets addicted to an email coupon service.

t: Sam & Cat S1 - #GoomerSitting
d: When Sam and Cat agree to babysit Goomer while Dice goes away, they misapply Goomer's medication which causes him to temporarily lose his eyesight before a big match.

t: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Mikey Does The Right Thing
d: To save his brothers, Mikey needs the help of Bishop's intern, ROD. But Rod wants something in return... to be turned into a MUTANT! To save the day, Mikey has to become... RESPONSIBLE.

t: Tales of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles S1 - Raph Thinks It Through
d: Raph's strength won't save him when he's caught between the Mechazoids and the notorious street gang known as Purple Dragons! Raph's going to have to use his head to get out of this one!

d: A new secret Krabby Patty formula has disastrous results for Bikini Bottom, and only SpongeBob can save the day. // Mr. Krabs and Plankton have to take boating school classes. Thankfully, SpongeBob's there to show them the ropes!

d: Patrick invents a new board game, and invites SpongeBob, Sandy and Squidward to play it with him. // After accidentally flushing Mr. Krabs' safe, SpongeBob and Squidward must go into the sewers to find it.

t: SpongeBob SquarePants S9 - SpongeBob LongPants / Larry's Gym
d: SpongeBob gets a pair of long pants, but they change his life in unexpected ways. // When Larry the Lobster opens a new gym in Bikini Bottom, SpongeBob becomes his best customer.
